design_philosophy.identity: E1 Anti-AI Design Protocol: High-contrast, tactical cyber-gaming intelligence hub. Rejects bland generic white cards in favor of deep obsidian glass, neon amber/cyan telemetry lines, and dense grid layouts.
principles: Tactical Minimalism: High density dark UI with translucent glass overlays and crisp 1px borders.
Cinematic Immersive Content: Hero sections with atmospheric background blur, dynamic video trailers, and high-impact key art.
Data-Rich Telemetry: Metacritic score dials, platform tags, release countdowns, and real-time trending charts.
Asymmetric Bento Grid: Mix dominant hero cards, tall stats panels, and micro grid pill badges.

key_features_and_pages.description: Featured game carousel with live video/backdrop, platform filter chips (PS5, Xbox, PC, Switch), trending top 10 list, recent game drop cards.
Filter games by platform (PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, PC, Nintendo Switch), sorting by release date, rating, or popularity.
Leaderboards of played games, rating breakdowns, player community metrics, metacritic score highlight.
Hero banner key art, trailer video launcher modal/embed, multi-screenshot viewer lightbox, metacritic badge, tags, store buy links (Steam, PlayStation Store, Xbox Store), system specs, user reviews.
Timeline grouped by month and week, countdown timers for major titles, one-click add to wishlist / set reminder.
Interactive AI companion ('Radar AI') for game advice, boss strategy, system specs check, personalized recommendations, and lore answers.
Emergent Google Sign-In integration, saved wishlist games, customized notification preferences.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always import fonts defined in typography.fonts_to_import in index.html or root CSS.
Use RAWG Live API (https://api.rawg.io/api/games) with a fallback key or proxy server in backend, and provide rich fallback mock data for smooth offline/instant loading.
Integrate Google Auth via Emergent overlay script (@emergentbase/overlay) and backend auth endpoints.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use pure white card backgrounds. Maintain dark mode with slate/obsidian containers.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when user adds/removes wishlist items or triggers action.
